blind_target.authors: Borreggine, K. L., & Kaschak, M. P.
blind_target.title: The action–sentence compatibility effect: It's all in the timing.
blind_target.evidence_quote: As a first step in assessing the replicability of motor compatibility effects, we conducted a pre-registered, multi-lab replication of the ACE. We used an adapted version of the original ACE paradigm (Glenberg & Kaschak, 2002) that was used in Borreggine and Kaschak (2006).
blind_target.outcome_quote: The results of the replication effort are clear: This version of the ACE was not statistically significant in any of the individual studies, and the meta-analytic effect size was close to zero (see Fig. 6).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The overall verdict is a clear failure for this version of ACE in all 18 labs, with a near-zero pooled effect.

luna_triage.reason: Source explicitly says its multi-lab study re-tests the ACE version used in Borreggine & Kaschak (2006) and reports the replication result. Shipped row 519 is Glenberg & Kaschak (2002), a distinct earlier original.
